svg.text: Zork2: rooms on a graph-paper lattice (3x3 per room)
U / D: up or down, drawn diagonally
dotted stub 'to N': links that cannot be drawn straight
dotted stub into blank space: maze / puzzle (left out)
circle: exit back to its own room
pink 'NO?': a routine decides this exit
dashed square: set down away from its neighbours
each room owns a 3x3 block; its 8 neighbours are pathway squares
